expectation: The expelled gas will meet and mix with the surrounding tail gas.

reaction: The contrast between the merged star staying behind and its matter travelling onward was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the merged star's expanding gas with the tail gas was worthwhile because it followed the lost matter into a new setting.

leastWorthwhile.text: Neither action felt especially confusing or repetitive, though the first encounter was the more obvious choice.

surprise.text: The pair itself merged while the incoming third star departed; the earlier stellar encounters had not involved surface contact.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the approaching star explained the first encounter, and the expelled gas suggested the second.

continue.text: I would continue: following material across encounters and seeing how its history changes is interesting.
